label: MnO2
note: rutile/pyrolusite-type; Mn4+ is d3, physically magnetic (MnO2 is a known antiferromagnet) -- needs the same spin-polarized exception as O2; MP itself reports this structure as is_metal=True (gap=0), a plausible symptom of the well-known GGA self-interaction-error failure mode for correlated Mn oxides -- flagged, not corrected, no +U used here
